Website Development & Digital Services

Doyen Website Developer provides website development and digital presence services for startups and small businesses in Jamshedpur and Bangalore and beyond. Projects fit one of two tiers, with a custom quote for each.

What is included in each service tier?

There are two service tiers: Website Essentials for establishing a professional online presence, and Website Growth for businesses that need stronger UX, e-commerce and conversion infrastructure. Pricing is custom and quoted per project.

How long do website projects take, and what technology is used?

Project length depends on scope, content readiness and how quickly feedback is given; a timeline is agreed before work begins.

A focused landing page generally takes less time than a multi-page business website or a store with many products. Having your text, images and branding ready speeds things up.

Technology is chosen to fit your needs rather than used by default. Depending on the project, this may include:

  • Hand-built HTML, CSS and JavaScript for fast, lightweight sites
  • Content management systems where clients need to edit content themselves
  • E-commerce platforms for online stores

For the full process, see how projects work.

Services in detail

Website Development

What it is

Website development is the design, build and launch of a site that presents your business, products and services online. For most small businesses this means a clear, multi-page business website with the essentials: services, about, contact and proof of your work.

Who it is for

Startups, local businesses, professionals and service businesses that need a credible website, or whose current site is slow, dated or hard to use on a phone.

Why it matters

For most customers your website is the first impression and the place they check before getting in touch. A site that is clear and quick to use makes that decision easier.

How Doyen approaches it

Doyen starts with what the business sells and who it sells to, then builds only the pages and features that support that. Content and structure come before decoration.

What is included

  • Custom page structure planned around your services
  • Responsive, mobile-first build
  • Contact forms and clear calls to action
  • Technical SEO foundations
  • Analytics setup and deployment

Related work

Sample Business Website

What does a business website usually include?

A business website usually includes a home page, a services or products page, an about page, a contact page and some form of proof such as a portfolio. The exact set depends on how your customers decide, which is agreed during the planning stage.

Get a Custom Quote

E-commerce Websites

What it is

An e-commerce website lets customers browse products and buy them online. It combines product pages, a cart and checkout, payments and order handling.

Who it is for

D2C brands, retailers and makers who want to sell online, and existing stores that need a clearer shopping experience.

Why it matters

Online shoppers leave when a store is confusing or slow, particularly on mobile. Clear product pages and a simple checkout remove avoidable friction.

How Doyen approaches it

Doyen designs the shopping journey first, then chooses the platform that suits the catalogue, the budget and who will manage the store day to day.

What is included

  • Store structure and product page design
  • Cart and checkout experience
  • Mobile-first shopping flow
  • Product page SEO foundations
  • Platform selection to fit your catalogue and budget

Related work

Sample Online Store

Which platform is best for an online store?

The best platform depends on the size of your catalogue, your budget, the payment methods you need and who will manage the store. Doyen recommends one after understanding those points rather than defaulting to a single tool.

Get a Custom Quote

Landing Pages

What it is

A landing page is a focused page built around one action, such as requesting a quote, booking a call or signing up. It leaves out the distractions of a full website.

Who it is for

Businesses running a campaign, launching a product or service, or collecting enquiries from a specific audience.

Why it matters

When someone arrives from an advert or a link, a page that speaks directly to their need is easier to act on than a general home page.

How Doyen approaches it

Doyen agrees the single goal first, then arranges every section to move a visitor towards it without pressure or dark patterns.

What is included

  • One clear goal and a page built around it
  • Persuasive but honest copy structure
  • Fast mobile layout
  • Form or contact setup
  • Basic analytics so you can see what is happening

Related work

Sample Landing Page

When do I need a landing page instead of a full website?

You need a landing page when you want visitors to take one specific action, usually after clicking an advert or a link. A full website suits an ongoing presence; a landing page suits a focused campaign. Many businesses use both.

UI/UX Design

What it is

UI/UX design shapes how a website looks (interface design) and how it works for the person using it (user experience). It covers layout, typography, colour, navigation and the order in which information appears.

Who it is for

Businesses launching a new site, redesigning a confusing one, or wanting a design that reflects their brand rather than a generic template.

Why it matters

Good design is mostly about clarity. Visitors should know what you offer, why it matters and what to do next within a few seconds.

How Doyen approaches it

Doyen designs from content outward, tests layouts at phone width first, and keeps the visual style restrained so the business, not the decoration, is the focus.

What is included

  • Page structure and navigation planning
  • Wireframes and visual design
  • Responsive layouts for phone, tablet and desktop
  • Accessible colour, type and focus states
  • Design handed over ready to build

Related work

See the ui/ux portfolio

What is the difference between UI and UX design?

UI design is how the site looks, covering colour, type and layout, while UX design is how it works for the visitor, covering navigation, flow and clarity. Good websites need both to work together.

Get a Custom Quote

SEO-ready Websites

What it is

An SEO-ready website is built so search engines and AI answer tools can find, read and understand it. That means fast pages, clean structure, descriptive headings, proper metadata, a sitemap and structured data.

Who it is for

Any business that wants people to find it online, including local businesses wanting to appear for searches in their city.

Why it matters

Search visibility rests on a technically sound site and genuinely useful content. Foundations do not guarantee rankings, but a poorly built site makes visibility much harder.

How Doyen approaches it

Doyen builds the foundations in from the start rather than adding them afterwards, and does not promise rankings, because nobody can.

What is included

  • Clean semantic HTML and heading structure
  • Unique titles and descriptions per page
  • XML sitemap and robots.txt
  • Structured data matched to visible content
  • Search Console setup and performance checks

Related work

Sample Business Website

What makes a website SEO-ready?

A website is SEO-ready when it can be crawled, loads quickly, works well on mobile, has clear headings and unique metadata, and explains your business in visible text. It also needs useful content, which technical work alone cannot replace.

Branding

What it is

Branding is the visual and verbal identity of a business: its name presentation, logo direction, colours, typography and tone of voice. It makes a business recognisable and consistent.

Who it is for

New businesses establishing an identity, and established ones whose look no longer reflects who they are.

Why it matters

A consistent identity builds familiarity and trust across your website, social profiles and printed material.

How Doyen approaches it

Doyen keeps brand work practical: a small, well-defined system that can actually be maintained, built alongside the website so the two fit.

What is included

  • Colour and typography system
  • Logo direction and usage guidance
  • Tone-of-voice notes
  • Brand applied to the website
  • Assets prepared for social and print

Related work

Can you create branding together with my website?

Yes, branding and website work can be done together, which usually gives a more consistent result. The scope of the branding work is agreed at the start of the project.

Social Media Content

What it is

Social media content is the posts, graphics and short-form material a business shares on its social profiles, designed to match its brand.

Who it is for

Businesses that want their social presence to look consistent with their website and brand.

Why it matters

Social profiles are often where people first meet a business before visiting its website. Consistency across both helps them recognise you.

How Doyen approaches it

Doyen designs reusable templates and a content direction, so your social presence stays consistent and easy to maintain.

What is included

  • Post and story templates in your brand style
  • Content ideas aligned with your services
  • Profile visuals and highlights
  • Links and calls to action back to your site

Common questions about cost and timing

How much does a business website cost?

The cost depends on the scope of the project, so Doyen provides a custom quote rather than a fixed price list. The main factors are the number of pages, how much custom design is needed, features such as e-commerce or booking, and whether content or branding support is needed. Send a short description through the contact page to get a quote.

How long does website development take?

The timeline depends on the size of the project and how quickly content and feedback are provided. A focused landing page generally takes less time than a multi-page business website or an online store. A realistic timeline is agreed in the planning stage, before the work starts.
